author: 130R
body:
130R, previously ObsidianFire99 here. I created the original checkmate, which those of you with long memories might remember as a short-lived but reasonably popular Nebula map.

Sadly, the original checkmate had some issues, most notably:

Overpowered loot: Loot behind each teams spawn was originally intended to be only accessible as a prize for members of the opposing team who managed to sneak behind the enemy lines. However, as this was not possible pre-Avicore, it meant that knowledgeable players would just bridge back to their own side's loot at the start of the game, and gameplay would be damaged due to a few 'god' players who would be almost unbeatable.

Easy spawn-killing: A small spawn with a single tight exit; easily blocked resulting in spawn-killing and damaged gameplay

So, the future? I am working on an updated match under the working title of Checkmate: Rematch. It will fix the issues with the original map and will hopefully introduce some interesting and original gameplay elements previously unseen in nebula. Like the original checkmate, it will aim to push expectations of how nebula maps should be, with carefully thought out map design designed to optimise the benefits for clever strategy and emphasise the importance of territory.

Feedback Appreciated.
